title: Yellow Vest
about: A costume vest whose wear and stains became a physical record of a week that changed me.
description: This track uses a yellow costume vest as a symbol for everything that happened over one intense week at State Arts-In. It began bright and new, but every performance, handshake, loose button, layer of dust, and shared moment left another mark on it. By the end, both the vest and the person wearing it had changed. The wear wasn't something to erase; it became proof of the experiences that had shaped me.

Lyrics: First day of the week, bright as the sun,
Pulled it on without a second thought,
Never guessing what we'd all go through.
Just another costume for another show,
I thought I'd wear that yellow vest...
I never thought it'd wear me in.
That yellow vest wasn't yellow anymore,
Not by the end of the week.
Every smile somebody shared with me.
Dust and sweat, applause and time,
Left their mark where memories lie.
It wasn't dirt that changed its color...
It was seven days of life.
Each one leaving just a little left.
The week kept writing on that cloth
I could've washed the dirt away,
Made it bright like it had been.
That yellow vest wasn't yellow anymore,
I walked into the fair one person,
Walked back home with changed eyes.
Because somewhere in those seven days...
